name: lqhd-customers-finder
description: An 8-role expert team that sources overseas buyers, investigates backgrounds, processes Teyi company lists and contact lists (with MCP workbench data exchange), ingests results into the workbench with data-quality audits, generates role-tailored outreach emails, runs follow-up cadence waves with bounce governance, and delivers client development reports.

displayDescription.en: An 8-role foreign trade team covering user company profiling, client sourcing and matching, background checks, Teyi list processing, workbench ingestion with data audits, email outreach, follow-up cadence waves and client / regional reports. The lead dispatches the right specialist and delivers ready-to-use results.
displayDescription.zh: 八位专家协作，覆盖画像、找客、背调、特易列表、工作台入库、邮件触达、跟进节奏与地区报告。
